230 ༄7ོdza rgyud kyi 'grel r+pā phyogs bsgrigs/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rnam bshad gso ba rig snang ba las/ gso byed thabs kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o//rtsa ba'i sabacad gsum pa/ mjug gi don bshad pa/le'u drug pa/ dpe don gyi rnam grangs rnam par bkod pa/de nas rtsa rgyud dngos kyi le'u gsum gyi mjug bsdu ba rtsis kyi le'u 'chad pa la/ de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig/ gnas lugs ngos 'dzin gso ba'i rtsa ba la//rnam gyur ma gyur blta reg dri ba dang // zas spyod sman dpyad sdong po dgu ru dril// yal ga lus la nad zungs dri ma gsum// nad la rgyu rkyen 'jug sgo gnas dang lam// ldang dus 'bras bu ldog rgyu mdo don dgu/ blta ba lce chu reg pa rtsa la gsum// dri ba slong rkyen na lugs goms pa gsum// zas la zas skom drug ste spyod lam gsum// sman la ro dang nus pa gnyis gnyis drug/sbyar thabs zhi byed drug dang sbyong byed gsum// dpyad gsum bzhi bcu rtsa bdun gyes pa yin// rgyas pa'i lo 'dab dang po nyi shu lnga// nad kyi zin tig drug cu rtsa gsum dang // blta ba drug dang reg pa'i rtsa rgyud gsum// dri ba nyer dgu rlung zas bcu bzhi dang // mkhris zas bcu gnyis bad kan zas skom dgu/ spyod lam drug dang sman gyi ro nus dgu/ khu ba gsum dang sman mar rnam pa lnga// thang phye bzhi bzhi ril bu rnam pa gnyis// tres sam lnga dang mi 'da'i bcos thabs dgu/ dpyad sde bdun te nad gzhi brgyad cu brgyad//sum cu rtsa brgyad ngos bzung brtag pa ste// bcos pa'i thabs la dgu bcu rtsa

༄༅ṣan lag brgyad pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rnam bshad gsob rig pa'i snang ba/ 231brgyad do// spyir sdoms nyis brgya rtsa bzhir rgyas pa yin// me tog nad med tshe ring gsal ba la// 'bras bu chos nor bde ba gsum du smin// dpe dang sbyar te rnam grangs bkod pa yi// snying po lta bur bsdus pa'i rtsa rgyud 'di// shes rab blo ldan 'ga' yi spyod yul las// blo rmongs skye bo rnams kyis rtogs mi 'gyur// spros dga' rgya chen gzhung du blta bar gyis/ zhes gsungs/ de ltar mya ngan med kyi ljon shing gi rtsa ba lta bu gsum/ de las skyes pa'i sdong po dgu de las gyes pa'i yal ga lta bu bzhi bcu rtsa bdun/ de las gyes pa'i lo ma lta bu nyis brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ de las 'dzum pa'i me tog dang 'dra ba gnyis/ de dag las smin pa'i 'bras bu lta bu gsum dang bcas pa'i mjug bsdu ba ni/ de dag gi rnam grangs tsam gyi sgo nas gsungs so// de'i phyir shes rab chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis ni/ rtsa rgyud 'di tsam la brten nas kyang gso ba rig pa'i don mtha' dag rtogs par 'gyur gyi/ blo gros dman pa rnams kyis rtsa rgyud tsam la brten nas de ltar rtogs par mi 'gyur bas/'chad par 'gyur ba'i rgyud phyi ma gsum la sogs pa gso ba rig pa'i gzhung rgya chen po rnams su blta bar gyis shig/ ces thugs brtse ba chen pos gdams pa yin no//yan lag brgyad pa las/ drang srong rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pas legs par bshad pa'i gzhung ni ngoms mi shesapa rgya cher yod mod kyi/ drang srong chen po gzings can dang / me bzhin 'jug la sogs pa'i drang srong rnams kyis lhan cig blo mthun par byas te 'dus nas/ drang srong me bzhin 'jug gis drang srong rgyun shes kyi bu la the tshom bcad de zhus pa'i skabs nas bdag gis mdo'i don mdor bsdus pa 'di bshad pa yin no// bcom ldan 'das/'di na kha cig nad pa snying stobs dang ldan pa dang / sman gyi yon tan dang sman pa rgan po rnams kyi lung dang mthun par byas kyang / nad kyis lus zad

232 ༄7dza rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogasabasgrigs/kyangasrog 'gyur bar snang ba yod/ la la ni sman dang dpyad ma byas kyang zhi bar snang ste/ 'on kyang phan pa dang mi phan pa'i 'bras bu'i bye brag nges pa med par snang na 'dir bstan bcos kyis zhi bar byed pa'i rtog pa ni ci zhig yin zhes dris pa dang / me bzhin 'jug la sogs pa slob ma'i tshogs rnams la de nyid kyi don ma lus pa sus bshad pa de ltar gso bar byas pa dang / ma byas pa yang mnyam zhing bye brag med de/ nad gso ba'i yan lag drug cu dang mi ldan zhing gso bar ma byas kyang nad med par 'gyur ba yang yod mod kyi/'on kyang nad kyi 'dam du bying ba la lag pa nas 'dren pa lta bu ni sman yin no//srog 'tsho bar 'dod pa thams cad kyi 'dren par 'gyur ba ni sman yin no//'di ltar nad gso ba'i cho ga yal bar mi bor zhing nges par blang bar bya ste/cho ga bzhin du byas na gso bar rung ba yin no// zhes gsungs so//de yang gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs chen mo 'di nyid las ji skad bshad pa ltar/ rnam par gyur pa'i nad kyi sdong po las gyes pa'i nad kyi yal ga dang lo ma lta bu rnams/ ngos 'dzin rtags kyi yal ga dang lo ma lta bu rnams kyi sgo nas ma nor bar ngos bzung ste/ gso byed kyi thabs bzhi'i yal ga dang lo ma lta bu rnams kyis legs par gsos pa na/ gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos chen po 'di thos bsam dang lag len gyi sgo nas nyams su blangs pa'i dgos pa/ gso bya'i nad pa rnams nad dang bral te lus rten de la nad med pa'i me tog lta bu dang / de'i stobs kyis tshe ring du gnas pa'i me tog lta bu gnyis 'dzum zhing / de dag las chos dang nor dang bde ba ste 'bras bu lta bu gsum smin par 'gyur ro// zhes pa'o// de yang yin te/ yan lag brgyad pa las/ sngon gyi drang srong rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pas bshad pa/ tshe ring ldan par 'dod pa na// chos dang nor yang bde bar sgrub// tshe yi rigs turig3byed lung bshad pa// rab tu gus pa'i bya bar gyis// zhes dang / 'di

༄༅khin lag brgyad pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rnam bshad gsob rig pa'i snang ba/ 233bklags rtogs dang nyams blangs pas// tshe ring ba dang nad med dang //chos dang nor dang bde dang grags// nges par 'thob par 'gyur ba yin//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rnam bshad gso ba rig pa'i snang ba las/ dpe don gyi rnam grangs rnam par bkod pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o//'dir smras pa/ gang gi mtshan tsam thos dang dran pas kyang / sdug bsngal kun las skyob pa bla na med// rgyu 'bras nad sel sman gyi bla ma des//bdag gi tshe rabs kun gyi mgon skyabs mdzod// bcom ldan bde gshegs sman pa'i rgyal po la// sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas slar yang 'dud// thugs rje'i chu 'dzin rol ba'i dkyil 'khor las// byin rlabs dngos grub char gyis tshim par mdzod// skye dang skye bar sman pa'i rgyal po yi// byin rlabs 'phrin las snying la zhugs pa las// sems can mgon med rnams kyi mgon dang ni//skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs su bdag gyur cig/ lus sems sdug bsngal dag las grol ba dang // bde dga'i dpal la spyod par 'dod pa sogs// ma lus 'gro ba'i 'dod pa 'jo ba la// sman pa'i rgyal po nyid dang mtshungs par shog/gso ba rig pa'i snang byed bris pa las// byung ba'i bsod nams phung po ji snyed kun// nam mkha'i mtha' ru bcas pa'i sems can la// mi zad phan bde 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ ces bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rnam bshad gso ba rig pa'i snang ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gong gi mi snas gsungs bkod ltar/ tshe yi rig byed 'dzin pa'i ming la brten pa'i sman rams pa ye shes rgya mtsho zhes bya bas/ rgya bod hor sogs kyind pa phreng ltar bsgrigs pa la bdud rtsi sman gyi sbyin pa sogs legs byaspobargya phrag gi sgo 'phar yangs por phye ba'i ba yan rdzong gi sman gyi pho brang chen por brisapa'i yi ge ba ni 'tsho byed mgon po rgya mtsho'o/ sarba mgi lam̐/ //
༄7// rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i gzhunyi ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//lha bo brag wa/

237rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/gzhung 'di'i rtsom pa po lha bo brag pa'i yab yum gyi mtshan dang /'khrungs 'das kyi lo tshigs/ 'khrungs yul sogs kyi yig cha'i skor ma rnyed kyang / mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu dang byams pa 'phrin las sogs kyis mdzad pa'i 〈gso rig rgyud bzhi'i sdong 'grems 'dod 'byung nor bu'i mdzod 〉ces pa'i nang du snga rabs pa lha bo brag pas mdzad pa'i 〈rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma 〉zhes pa sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sku ngo mas mchan 'god mdzad ces 'khod yod pa ltar na/ sku nyid ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs kyi mkhas chen zhig yin par mngon//

238rang bzhin lhun grub 'bras bu'i mthar phyin cing //d+ngha sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las bsam yas// 'gro ba ma lus sgrol mdzad pas// ston pa sman lha de la phyag 'tshal lo/ ra chod mkhan la/ bla ma'i drin dang bka' lung rig pa yis/ skal ldan rjes 'jug rnams la phan phyir du// 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma bgo/ rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po/ lung thams cad kyi spyi 'brel('grel3/ man ngag thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ zhes pa la sogs pa che ba'i yon tan bcu bdun dang ldan pa/ rgyud lung man ngag gsum gyi zab don phyogs gcig tu dril nas ston pa'i rgyud chen po 'di bshad na/ khog 'bugs pa brjod bya'i don dang / sa bcad pa bsdus pa'i don dang / 'bru gnyer ba tshig gi don dang / nyams su blangs pa chog sdebs kyi don dang / gags tugegs3gsal (bsal3ba brgalalan gyi don dang lngas ston te/ dang po logs su shes/ tha ma bzhir zhor la ston to// sa bcad pa la gsum ste/bka' rang gnyer gyi sa bcad/ rgyud bzhi yan lag brgyad/ gnas bcu gcig skabs bco lnga/ mdo bzhi/ le'u brgya dang lnga bcu drug go/ slob dpon gdams ngag gi sa bcad nas/ rgyu gleng gzhi/ rkyen gleng bslang /'bras bu rgyud don/ dgos 'grel/ rgyud don bsdus shing gdams te gtad pa'o// 'chad mkhan rig pas sa bcad na/ spyi don gsum ste/ slad tuklad3kyi don dang / gzhung gi don dang / mjug gi don dang /

༄༅kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud donagasal ba'i nyi ma/ 239 rtsa ba'i sabacad dang po/ klad kyi don— bshad pa/ —dang po la gnyis/ skad gnyis 'gyur gyi sgo nas rgyud kyi mtshan bstan pa dang / ston pa la phyag 'tshal te mchod par brjod do//dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du nas/ zhes bya ba'i bar gyis ston te/ spyir bstan pa la mtshan 'dogs lugs ni/ gnas la mtshan du btags pa/bsil ba'i mtshan gyi mdo lta bu/ dus la mtshen du btags pa/ dkon mchog ta la lta bu/ dpa' la mtshan du btags pa'i/ gser 'od dam pa'i ljon shing bzang po'i mdo lta bu/ zhu ba po la mtshan du btags pa/ des pas zhus pa/ blo gros bzang pos zhus pa lta bu/ sho lo ka la mtshan du btags pa/ stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa/ nyi khri lnga stong pa/ brgyad stong pa lta bu/ don la mtshan du btags pa ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'am/ rdzogs pa chen po kun byed rgyal po lta bu ste/ mtshan gyi 'dod ('dogs3lugs tha dad pa las/ rgyud 'di don la mtshan du btags pa ste/ de la yang don gyi gtso bo la btags pa dang /rnam grangs las btags pa dang / ngo bo las btags pa dang / 'dir gsum ka las so// de yang gtso bo las btags pa ni/ bdud rtsi snying po/rnam grangs las btags pa yan lag brgyad pa/ ngo bo las btags pa gsang ba man ngag gi zhes pas/ gso dpyad thams cad kyi brjod bya'i don thams cad 'dir 'dus pa'i phyir ro// de lta bu'i mtshan don dang ldan pa de bshad pa la bdun te/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ dgos don/ bsdus don/tshig don/ brgal lan no//

240 ༄༅kho rgyudakyi 'grel pa phyogs bsgrigs/dang po mtshan gyi ngo bo ni/ brjod bya don rgyud dang / rjod byed tshig brjod kyi don 'dus pa'o//gnyis pa nges tshig ni/ don mtshon nus pa'i phyir dang / don la 'jug pa'i phyir mtshan no//gsum pa dbye ba ni/ mtshan gyi 'dogs tshul tha dad pa las/ 'dir don gyi ngo bo las btags pa dang / don rgya che ba dang / rnam grangs las btags pa/ don zab pa las btags pa ste/ gong gis shes so//bzhi pa dgos pa'i don la gsum/ spyir mtshan smos pa'i dgos pa ni/sman pa mkhas pas lag gi rtsa la reg pas/ lus mgo mjug gi’nad ngos zin pa ltar/ shes rab kyi— dbang po rab kyis mtshan ldan pa trem la bsten nas gzhung dbu zhabs kyi don rtogs par 'gyur ba ste/ de yang lang khar (gar3bshegs tugashegs3pa las/ ming du gdags par ma mdzad na// 'jig rten thams cad rmongs par 'gyur// de bas rmongs pa gsal ba'i phyir// mgon pos ming du gdags par mdzad// ces gsungs so// mtshan slang du bkod pa'i dgos pa ni/ bstan pa'i mtshan la ma rmongs shing // mang po'i gseb nas rtsal (btsal3sla bas// skad gnyis smra ba'i dgos pa ni khungs btsun te/rgya gar chos kyi 'byung gnas nas brgyud pa yid ches pa dang / rgya skad sor bzhag na/ bod kyis mi go bas/ brda phrad tusprad1par bya ba dang / lo paṇa gyis drin dran pa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta'i skad la bag chags 'jog pa'i dgos pa'o//lnga pa bsdus pa'i don ni bzhi ste/ sgra dang skad kyi rgyu mtshan/ skad rigs dbye ba/ sgra'i bsgyur lugs/ rgya skad kyi don no//dang po ni/ rna ba'i dbang por gsal bas na sgra/ sgra des don gyi brda sprod pas na skad do// dbye ba ni/ rgya gar na skad rigs bi shan rtsi (pi shā tsi3dang / a ba brag shi lha (a ba r+bha sha3dang / pra ti (kṛkata dang / sang kri (saṃ

༄༅kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 241skṛ3ta la sogs pa mang du yod kyang / 'dir sang tri tusaṃ skṛ1ta'i skad las bsgyur ba'o// bsgyur lugs la/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ big pa tra'i bsgyur skad chen pos/ skad kyi dbyings tudabyangs3la tos tultos3te bsgyur ba dang / lo tsā ba'i rjes su 'brangs te/ spral skad sgra 'dod kyis bsgyur ba gnyis las/ 'dir gnyis kar 'jug kyang / phyi ma gtso che sgra drangs te bsgyur ba/ rim par bsgyur ba/ bsgyur te bsgyur ba/ nor bu lugs su bsgyur ba/ thad log tu bsgyur ba/ thang mar bsgyur ba ste drug las/rim par bsgyur ba'am/ nor bu lugs su'o// tha ma rgya skad kyi don ni/ skad rigs thams cad kyi 'byung sa yin pa dang / ston pa byon pa yin pas khungs btsun pa dang / bstan pa'i 'byung sa yin pas 'byung khungs btsun pa dang /gzhan gyi skad yongs su spang pa'o//tshig don la gnyis te/ sgra'i shan sbyar ba dang 'bru bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du/ a smri (mṛkata trī tha (hro da3ya am gha (aṅga3a shad (aṣ+ṭa3gu h+ya u pa dhī (de3sha tan+t+ra na (nā3ma zhes pa de rgya gar gyi skad do// de nyid bod skad du bsgyur ba'i lo tsā ba ni/ be+e ro tsa na zhes pa/ sgra bsgyur nyi shu rtsa gcig mkhyen pa des/ rgya gar gyi skad kyi sgra bsgyur/ yi ge'i lus bsgyur/bod kyi skad du go bde bar sgyur te/ a smri (mṛ1ta zhes pa de bsgyur bas bdud rtsi/ hro ta tud3ya las snying po/ agha kyi.arga3aṣ+ṭa las/ yan lag brgyad pa/gu ru ya (gu h+ya3las gsang ba pa/ u pa dhī (de3sha las man ngag/ tan+t+ra las rgyud/ na (nā3ma las zhes bya bar bsgyur cing / shan sbyar ba'o//'bru spyad (bshad1pa la gsum ste/ tshig gi don dang thun mong du bshad pa/ dpe dang sbyar te mtshan rgyud lung man ngag gsum dang sbyar te bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bdud rtsi zhes pa ni/ bdud ni sems can rnams la bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi las/ khyad par 'chi bdag gi bdud la bar du

242 ༄7kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogs bsgrigs/gcod la/ —'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis 'chi bdag 'joms pa ste/ smri tha tumṛ takazhes pa 'chi ba las byas pa/ de as kag (bkag3pas/ 'chi ba med pa zhes bya'o// yang bdud rtsi ni/ mi rnams lus nad kyis gdung ba dang /sems nyon mongs pas gdungs pas/ tshe la bar du gcod pas bdud/ de'i gnyen por zas spyod sman spyad tudapyad1bzhi btang bas na nad gsos tshe ring /'du ba ma snyoms pa nas ring du 'tsho bar gtso bo tshe ring du gnas te chos la longs spyad pas/ sems nyid dbu ma chen po'i don rtogs/ dug lnga rang bzhin gyi ye shes lngar grol bas bdud rtsi ste/ de yang dug gsum rgyu 'bras nad sel gong na med ces so// snying po zhes pa la gsum ste/ rgyu'i snying po/'bras bu'i snying po/ don gyi snying po/ dang po ni/ gso ba rig pa thams cad kyi rgyu'i snying po ste/ rgyu dug gsum las 'bras bu rlung mkhris bad kan 'byung bas/ de la 'phel zad gyur pas 'du ba cha snyoms pa'i thabs 'di nyid las 'phrod cing 'dus pa'o// de yang phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi nyes pa'i skyon gsalatubasalakye/ ma rig pa las byung ba'i dug gsum gyi nad thams cad zhi bar byas te zhes pas gsal lo// 'bras bu'i snying po ni/ 'byung ba lnga'i rgyu/ des skyod tuskyed3pa'i phyi nang snod bcud 'bras bu ste/ sa chu me sa chu me chu dang rlung // me rlung sa rlung gnyis kyis ro drug skyed// ces pa dang / sa steng sman min gang yang yod pa ma yin// zhes pas/ ro nus zhur (zhu3rjes sbyar thabs rnams kyi don yang rgyud 'di las byung bas 'bras bu'i snying po'o// bcud 'dus pa don gyi snying po yin te/gso spyad tudapyad3thamagacad kyi bcud rgyud 'dir 'dus te/ de yang thams cad 'dus pas rtsa rgyud thugs las byung ste/ zhes pas gsal lo// yan lag brgyad pa zhes pas/ gso bya'i yul brgyad la gnyen po gso thabs brgyad ston pas yan lag brgyad pa ste/ gang zhe na/ lus dang byis pa mo nad gdon//

༄༅kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 243mtshon dug rgas dang ro tsa ba// yan lag brgyad du shes par bya// zhes so//gsang ba zhes pa la gsum/ blo dman rnams kyis mi go mi rtogs pas rang bzhin gyis gsang ste/ de yang blo rmongs skye bo rnams kyis rtogs mi 'gyur zhes so// snod min rnams la sbas pas gsang ste// de ltar skal med snod dang mi ldan gsang / zhes so// gsum pa man ngag dang mi ldan pa rnams la gab pa'i tshul du gsang ste/ rgyud kyi don gting zab cing don dpag dka' ba'i phyir ro// de yang 'di nyid las/ kun la dkon pas dbu dam 'bar ba (u dum wa ra3'dra// mthong thos spyod pa skal ldan re re tsam// zhes so// man ngag ces pa ni/ bya sla tshig phyung (tshegs chung3don che dpag dka' nges par myur du bsgrub pa'i phyir ro// dang po ni/ sman thun res kyang nad zhi/ zas spyod gzab pa tsam gyis nad mi skye la/ skyes pa myur du zhi bar bya sla ba'o// don che de/ nad kyi zug gzer zhi nas tshe ring bar thub pa dang / longs spyod dbang dang dga' bde la spyod/ dam pa'i chos dang mthun pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob pa'o// dpag dka' ste/ rgyud kyi don gting zab pa'i phyir ro// myur du bsgrub ste/ de yang / bstan bcos chen po brgyad pa las/ 'di ltas rtagalodang nyams blangs pas// chos dang nor dang bde ba grags// myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba yin// zhes gsungs pas/ man ngag 'di dang ldan na rang gzhan gyi don myur du 'grub ste/ 'gro ba gzhan ni nad la (las3grol/ 'chi ba'i srog byin te tshe ring ba dang / rang la nor dang grags pa tshe 'dir bde ba/dus dang rgyun gyi spyod lam shes pas nad mi 'byung / nad byung yang sman spyad (dpyad3zas spyod bzhis 'du ba cha nyams (snyoms3termo/ nad mi 'byung bas tshe ring / chos la spyod pas mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'o// de yang 'di nyid las/ man ngag yon tan rgyud 'di nor bu 'dra//zhes so// gir (gi3zhes pa 'di/ mtshan dang rgyud du brda sprod pa'i phyir gi'o//

244 ༄༅kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogs bsgrigs/rgyud ces pa ni tshang zhing 'brel ba ste/ gleng gzhi gleng slong 'brel/ gleng klong (slong1rgyud don dang 'brel lo// tshang tutshangs3te spyi bo gtsug nas —rkang mthil yan chod kyi nad kyi rigs su gyur pa'i bcos thabs kun/ gso spyad skyidapyad1man ngag rgyud 'dir 'dus par bstan/ zhes pa dang / man ngag yon tan rgyud 'di nor bu 'dra// dgos pa ma tshang ba ni gcig kyang med//ces so// yang lung gzhan las/ rgyud ces bya ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ 'brel dang ma tshang med pa dang // phun sum tshogs pas rgyud ces bya// zhes so//zhes bya ba ni/ ston pas rgyud 'di don nges pa'i tshig tu gsungs/ gdul bya rnams kyis mtshan gyi don go bar byed pas na zhes bya'o// de yang 'di nyid las/ kye ma ho/ 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po nyid// thugs kyi 'od zer ma rig mun pa sel// thams cad 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud thugs las byung // zhes gsungs so//gnyis pa mtshan dpe dang sbyar te bshad pa ni/ bdud rtsi zhes pa rdzas gang yang sman du gyur pas nad gang yang sel ba/ khyad par dug gi nad zhi bar byed pa ste/ rtsi ma ghi lta bu'o// snying po ni/ gso ba rig pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad kyi snying po ste/ gser shin tu sbyangs pa'am/ mar gyi yang zhun lta bu'o// yan lag brgyad pa ni/ gso ba rig pa'i dgos pa la cha lagarnams ma tshang ba med pas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'o// gsang ba man ngag ni/ gang zag gang rung rung gi blo'i spyod yul du ma gyur te/ nyi ma'i dkyil lta bu'o// rgyud ni gong ma'i shugs las 'byung ba ste/ rgya nag dar gyi thag pa 'thags pa lta bu'o//mtshan rgyud lung man ngag gsum dang sbyar te bshad pa ni/ bdud rtsi ni rgyud dang brgyud khurgyud3kyi mtshan no// yan lag brgyad pa ni lung gi mtshan no//snying po/ gsang ba/ man ngag ni man ngag gi mtshan no// brgal ba ni mtshan

༄༅/rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 245rgyud don yin nam min/ mtshan du rgyud don 'dus sam ma 'dus/ skad gnyis smos pa'o// mtshan klad du stsos pas 'di rgyud don yin nam min/rgyud don yin na/ rgyud don chos can/ rgyu rkyen mi dgos par thal/ min na/gang zag dbang po rab de chos can/ mtshan tsam la brten nas rgyud don mi rtogs par thal/ mtshan rgyud don min pa'i phyir/ 'dod na mtshan gyi don 'di chos can/ 'di las gzhan pa'i rgyud don gcig yod par thal mtshan rgyud don ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtshan du 'dus sam ma 'dus/ byas pas 'dus na/ rgyud 'di mtshan ldan pa tsam gyis yan lag rtogs par thal/ci'i phyir na/ mtshan du rgyud 'dus la/ rgyud don yan lag brgyad yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa tshad mas grub bo// ma 'dus zer na/ rgyud don chos can/yan lag brgyad pa las gud pa'i brjod bya gcig yod dgos par thal/rtags ni mtshan don du rgyud don ma 'dus zer ba'i phyir/ zhes rig pas dpag go/ tha ma skad gnyis smos pa la/ rgya skad chos can/ bod skad kyi don ma yin pa'i brjod bya gcig yod dgos par thal/ zhe na/ skad gnyis gsungs pa'i phyir/ bod skad kyi brjod bya las gud pa'i don la treg (tsheg3med kyang / rgya skad smos pas/ sang tri (saṃ skṛ3ta'i skad la bag chags 'jog pa'i dgos pa yod na ci 'gal te/ khyab pa ma grub/ rang lugs la mtshan rgyud don yang yin te/ ston pa sku lnga lhun grub kyis gsungs pa'i mtshan don las gud pa'i rgyud don gzhan med pa'o// mtshan la rgyud don 'dus te rgyud lung man ngag tu 'dus pa'i phyir ro// skad gnyis dmos skyosmos3pa'i dgal (brgal1lan kyang / gong du dgos ched kyis bshad pas shes so//gnyis pa ston pa'i bdag nyid la phyag 'tshal ba gnyis te/ 'gyur byed lo tsā ba'i phyag dang / 'tshams skyomatshams3sbyor sdud pa po'i phyag go/dang po bcom ldan 'das nas phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i bar te/ de la

246 ༄༅kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogs bsgrigs/yang gsum/ phyag gi dgos pa/ gus tubasdus3pa'i don/ tshigarigi don no//dang po ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal bas/ rtsom pa dang 'chad pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i dgos pa dang / sgrib pa sbyang ba tshogs kyi lam sna zin pa'i dgos pa'o//bsdus pa'i don la lnga ste/ phyag gi rgyu mtshan/ dbye ba/ yul gang la 'tshal ba/ gang zag gang gis tshul ji ltar 'tshal ba'o// dang po ni/ rnam par rtog pa'i sdig sgrib 'phyag pas na/ phyag ston pa dang 'khor dbyer med du byams pa'i phyir na'ang phyag ces bya'o// dbye ba ni rje'i bla phyag skye bo'i zol phyag sngags pa'i zhes pa dgu sprugs kyi phyag nyan thos gsal 'debs kyi phyag mi shes kyis rjes kyi phyag la sogs pa'o// yul gang la btsal tu'atshal3na/ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla la/ gang zag rgyud pa po dang / lo tsā bas btsal ('tshalakalo// tshul ji ltar 'tshal na/ rab bstod pa lta bas btsal ('tshal1te/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang / bsdud skyosdud3pa po dang / lo tsā ba'i sems bskyed ye shes gnyis med du rtogs te/ pan tsa tra ma las/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang / de bzhimāmar la mar bzhag bzhin/ / rang gis rang rig ye shes ni// legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin// ces so// 'bring dgongs pa ting nge 'dzin gyis btsal te/ btsal bya'i yul nam mkha' gang ba la/ 'tshal byed kyi lus zhing gi sdug bsngal nyid du sprul te 'tshal lo// tha ma ni lus btud ngag dbyangs/ sems mos pa dang ldan pas/ sgo gsum zol med du 'tshal ba'o// de yang lus kyi phyag 'tshal smad (ma3lnga sa la gtugs// ngag gi phyag 'tshal bstod tshig dbyangs dang bca sa// yid kyi phyag 'tshal mos gus dungs pas bya// zhes so//tha ma tshig gi don ni/ bcom ldan 'das zhes pa ston pa chos kyi sku ste/rtsa rgyud ni byin gyis brlabs kyis gsungs pa'o// de la bcom ldan 'das zhes

༄༅/rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 247pa ni/ legs par sbyar pa sang tri (saṃ skṛ1ta'i skad las/ bha snya /ga3wan zhes bya ste/ bha gha (ga3zhes pa de bsgyur bas/ bcom zhes bya bar 'gyur la/wan ni ldan zhes pa'o// gang gis ci zhig bcom/ gang dag gang dang ldan zhes na/ thog mar nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa mtha' dag spangs pas/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom/ nyon mongs pa med pas gang gis kyang bar du gcod par mi nus te/ lha'i bu'i bdud bcom/ de bas na 'chi ba med de tshe la dbang thob pas/ 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/ 'chi ba med pas na phung po nying 'tshams (mtshams1sbyor ba med de phung po'i bdud bcom pa'o// de ltar mi mthun bdud bzhi bcom pas na bcom zhes btags te/ dpal rdo rje rtse mo las/ nyon mongs las dang de bzhin skyes// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib de bzhin// mi mthun phyogs kyi chos rnams gang // de bcom pas na bcom zhes brjod// ces so// yang bha ga a su zhes bya ba'i sgrar 'drangs (drangs3na ldan pa zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ dbang phyug la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi skal ba dang ldan pa'o// de yang ston pa 'di la lo ska na/ lha bdud tshangs pa la sogs pa gang gis kyang chos dang mthun dgol (dgos1pa med pa ste/ dbang phyug chen po'i bsang (ba3spu'i khung bu gcig la skal pa las lhag par tas (bltas3kyang chog mi shes de gzugs bzang ba'o// grags pa na gdul bya gang gnas pa'i sar bcom ldan 'das kyi grags pa snyan pas khyab cing yid tshim par byed pa ste/ lha rnams kyi bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa'o// zhes bya ba lta bu kun gyis 'dzin pa'o// dpal ni zhing khams dang //'khor gyi tshad yongs su bzung bar mi nus so// ye shes ni skad cig gcig gis khong du shes bya'i dal thams cad kyi ji snyed pa dang / ji lta ba mkhyen pa'o//brtsona'igrus ni/ skad cig ma gcig la gdul bya mtha' dag gi/ skal ba ji lta ba bzhin mdzad pa'o/ ji skad du/ dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang

248 ༄༅rte rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogs bsgrigs/dang // dpal dang grags dang ye shes dang / brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs ldan pa// drug po de la ldan tuskal1zhes brjod/ ces so// 'das zhes bya ba'i sgra ni/ bcom ldan 'das/ legs ldan/ skal ldan rnams nor so yod pas bcom ldan 'das zhes pa/ 'jig rten gyi legs ldan las khyad du bstan pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kho na mya ngan las 'das kyi/ gzhan ni de ltar min no 'ga' zhig ni/ sang tri jisaṃ ṣ+ṭṛ3ta'i skad du 'das kyi sgra med/ lo paṇa mkhas pa dag gis/ bla thabs su bsnan pa yin zer te/ khyad par gyis sgras/'das zhes pa ni shugs las 'byung bar bzhed do// de bzhin gshegs pa zhes pa ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas sman bla de/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad lha dang gzhal yas/ sku dang ye shes su snang bas ma nor ba de gzhan ma yin pa'am/ ma bcos pas zhing ste/ de'i don kho nar son pas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la gshegs te/ sku 'ja' tshon lta bu la mtshan dpes spras pa ma nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'o// dgra bcom pa zhes pa/ nyon mongs pa rtsad nas gcod pas/ bar chad med pa'i lam dgu dang / nyon mongs pa ma nges par gnas 'gyur te/ sa gong ma thob par byed pa rnam grol gyi 'bras bu dgu mthar phyin nas/ sa bcu rgyun gyi mthar rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/bag la nyal gyi sgrib pa cha phra ba yang bcom nas chos sku mngon du thob par byas pa'o// yang dag par rdzogs pa ni/ 'bras bu'i chos kyi stobs bcu dang / mi 'jig ('jigs3pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa bco brgyad mthar son pas/yang dag par byed de/ de dag ma stsal (bstsal3bar lhun gyis grub par rdzogs pa'i ston pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o// sangs rgyas ni spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pas te/ nyon mongs pa dang ma rig pa ngang gis sangs te/ mkhyen pa ye shes mtha' dbus med par kun tu rgyas pa'o// de yang / ma rig nyid (gnyid1las sangs phyir dang // shes bya la ni blo rgyas phyir// sangs rgyas

༄7kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 249pad+mo'i 'dab ltar rgyas// zhes so// sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po zhesapa ni/ rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i nad gsos nas/ lus sems la phan phyir bde ba'i phyir na sman zhes so// de yang sman pa'i gnas las/ nad gsos lus la phan phyir sman zhes so// zhes pa'i rkyen gyis sman pa rnams kyi bla ma'am lhar gyur te/ bstan bcos las/ 'dod dang khro ba gti mug sel byed pa'i sman pa sngon med de —la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas/ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla'i sngon du ni/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i nad sel nus pa'i sman pa gzhan ni ma byung bas/ sangs rgyas sman bla de/ sman pa rnams kyi lha'o// 'di la g.yu thog mgon pos bzhed kyi/ lha ma yin bla yin/ lhas srung skyob tsam las mi nus te/bla mas ni sems nyid chos kyi sku dang / 'phrad nas 'khor ba myang 'das kyi mtha' las thar bar byed nus pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs so// sku mdog mthing ka ni/ kha dog gzhan zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir ro// be+e ḍūr+ya ltar sku'i gnas nas 'od zer kha dog dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ nad kyi dgra las rgyal bas rgyal po'o// la zhes pa ni/ bdun pa'am bzhi pa'i dgra mis (sgra yikagasungs te/ phyag gi yul mtshon pa dang / gnas gzhi dang dgos byed mtshon par byed pa la/ phyag 'tshal ba'i yul mtshon par byed pa'i phyir ram yang na yul dang phyag tu 'tshams (mtshams3sbyor ba'i phyir ro//sdud pa'i phyag ni/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad bcom ldan 'das//zhes pa bzhis ston te/ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla'i thugs rjes khams gsum gyi sems can rnams nyon mongs pas bzir (gzirakyebar mkhyen te/ gzigs tshul ni ji ltar mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis ma dmigs par gzigs pas/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis ma 'gad('gag3par gzigs/ ma dmigs pa dang / ma 'gag pa/ gnyis su med par gzigs so// gzigs nas thugs rjes bskyed de/ rtag pa rgyun gyi thugs rje chu bo'i rgyun lta bu/ rang bzhin

250 ༄7rte rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogasabasgrigs/shugs kyi thugs rje nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ yul dang phrad pa'i thugs rje/ skyes bu 'dod chags can 'gro ba bzang mo dang phrad pa lta bu/ bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa'i thugs rje/ 'bangs kyis rje la pha phabs blangs pa lta bur skyes te/'gro ba'i domāmadzad de/ 'gro ba phal mo che rnams kyi mgon dang skyabs mdzad tshul gsum ste/ rten can gyi don mdzad pa/ bram ze'i mchod stong bsgrub pa lta bu/ rten med kyi don mdzad pa drang srong smod kha grub pa lta bu/ gnyis su med pa'i don mdzad pa nam mkha' dga'o phye ba lta bu'o// de lartse'adir gnyis su med pa'i don mdzad pa'o// bcom ldan 'das zhes pa'i don ni/ gong du bkral yod do// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal skyob ces pa ni/sangs rgyas sman bla'i mtshan tsam 'gro ba sems can gang gis thos pas yon tan byin brlabs ni/ ngan 'gro'i srid pa'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag sel bar nus shing skyob pa'o// dug gsum ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum gyis nad rlung mkhris bad kan gsum bskyed pa de 'dod chags longs skur/zhe sdang sprul skur/ gti mug chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te/ dug gsum dang des bskyed pa'i/ rlung nad la bcud/ mkhris pa la gsil(bsil3/ bad kan la tsub la gro khudro3ba'i gnyen po gtong zhing / nad rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa sel zhing ma rig pa sangs te ye shes mtha' dbus med par rgyas pa'i phyir 'gro ba rnams kyi sman pa yin la sman pa rna mas kyi ni bla ma'o// be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od la phyag 'tshal ba'i 'bras bu gong du bstan zin to//

༄7kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 251rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyisapa/ gzhung gi don bshad pa/gnyis pa gzhung gi don la bdun te rgyu gleng gzhi/ rkyen gleng bslang /'bras bu rgyud don/ dgos 'grel/ gdams gtad/ rdzogs mtshan/'gyur byang ngo //le'u dang po/ gleng gzhi/dang po gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po bstan pa la gnyis/ gzhung dang mtshan no// gzhung la mdo dang rgyas pa'o//dang po ni/ 'di skad bdag gis bshad pa'i dus gcig na/ ces pas ston te/ de la gsum/ phyi ltar bshad pa/ nang ltar bshad pa/ gsang ba ltar bshad pa'o//dang po ni sang tri tusaṃ skṛ3ta'i sgra las/ e bam ma ya e ka smin sa ma ye/sru ta zhes bya ste/ e zhes pa/ 'di zhes pas gnas te/ de la mtshan nyid gsum/ mthu che/ yid du 'ong ba/ gzhan las khyad du gyur pa'o// dang po ni/drangasrong gi gnas zhes pa/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi gnas te/ me chu rlung gsum gyi bskal pas mi shigs pas mthu che/ gnyis pa sman gyi grong khyer lta na sdug ste/ kun gyi yid du 'ong ste/ lta bas mi ngoms te spro ba skye ba'o// gsum pa rin po che sna lnga las grub pa ste/ ye shes kyi rin po che de/ 'jig rten pa'i lha'i khang pa las kyang khyad du gyur pa'o// bam zhes pa de skad ces pa'i ston pa

252 ༄gyirte rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogasabasgrigs/de/ bsod nams yongs su rdzogs pa'i ston pa/ be+e ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po'o//ma zhes pa bdag gis zhes pas/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ste/ de la gsum/nyid dang gnyis su med pa'i 'khor/ sprul pa'i 'khor/ dad pas 'dus pa'i 'khor/ dang po ni/ drang srong yid las skyes te/ ston pa nyid kyi gsung las sprul pa'i phyir/ gnyis su med pa'am lhan cig pa'i 'khor/ gnyis pa ni/lha dang drang srong / phyi pa/ nang pa'i 'khor bzhis bskor te/ zhes pas/sprul pa'i 'khor/ gsum pa ni/ 'khor mang po dang thabs cig tu/ zhes pas/ dad pa 'dun gyi 'khor/ lha dang / klu dang / lha srin sde brgyad la sogs/ dad pa 'dun dang ldan pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o// yang zhes pa/ bshad pa'i zhes pas/ chos phun sum tshogs pa ste/ gleng bzhi (gzhi3gleng bslang rgyud 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen du byung ste/ yongs su shes pa rgyud don gyi dngos so// rgyud bzhi/ yan lag brgyad/ gnas skabs mdo/ le'u rnams so// bstan pa mi nub par bya ba'i phyir/ gdams shing ltad (gtadakapa dang gsum mo// sa ma ye zhes pa/ dus gcig na/ zhes pas/ ston pa dang 'khor/ gnas gcig tu 'dzoms pa'i dus te/ e ka smin sru ta zhes pas phun sum tshogs pa lnga 'dzoms pa'i dus gcig na zhes pa ste/ ston pa 'khor gsum 'dzoms pas bstan pa dang / dus shugs la 'byung ste/ bstan pa ni ston pa'i thugs la mnga' 'o// dus ni ston 'khor gnas gcig tu tshogs pa'i dus de ka la dus zhes so// la la dag gis bzhed pas phun sum tshogs drug du 'dod de/ sdud pa po ni 'khor gyi khongs su gtogs pas/ kho bo ni lnga ru 'thad par 'dod de/ ngo bo bsdu na gsum du 'dus te/ ye shes rdzogs pa'i rgyud las/ gnas dang ston pa 'khor 'tshogs na// dus dang bstan pa shugs las 'byung // zhes pas gsal lo//gnyis pa nang ltar bshad pa ni/ 'di zhes pa/ gnas rkang mthil lha

༄༅rte rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 253lam rlung gi dal/ sgrom mdo gru gsum me'i dal/ lto ba ldum (zlum3po chu'i dal/ brang gru bzhi sa'i dal/ sgal tshigs kyi ri/ rkang lag bzhi ni gling bzhi(gzhi3/ lhu tshigs brgyad ni gling phran brgyad/ mig gnyis ni nyin tunyinazla/sems stong pa ni nam mkha'/ dbugs phyi nang brgyu (rgyu1ba rlung / drod ni me /khrag dang chu ser ni phyi nang gi rgya mtsho gnyis/ lpags skyipags3pa ni lcags ri/rus pa ni brag gnyer sul ni 'ja'i rwa ba/ bas (ba3spu rnams ni 'od zer sna tshogs pa de lta bu'i dbus na/ gzhal yas khang ni/ tsi ta rin chen ni dbus kyi lte ba/ rtsa chen bzhi las yal ga gnyis gnyis su gyes pas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ glo mchin dang mkhal ma gnyis ni/ gru chad bzhi byang logs ni 'khyams/ kha rna ba shangs ni sgo bzhi/ snod drug pho mo'i gsang ba gnyis te/brgyadani ta (rta3babs/ lce 'dod yon/ so dra ba dra phyed/ mgo bo ni rgya phubs/ dbang po lnga dang yul lnga ni gzhal yas khang gi rgyan no// skad ces pa/snying gi dkyil na srog mi gshegs pa'i thig le/ rang gi rigs byang chub kyi sems ni ston pa'o// bdag gis zhes pa ni/ 'khor rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad dang / lhan cig pa ni 'khor/ bshad ces pa rnam par shes pa gsal zhing rig pa sna tshogs su 'char zhing ma 'gags pa ni bstan pa'o//dus gcig na zhes pas/ srog gis 'tsho zhing tshe ring ba'i dus ni phun sum tshogs pa'o// de ltar gleng bzhi (gzhi3rang la gnas kyang / phal gyis ni mi go zhing nang zhes bya'o//gsang bar bya ba las kyis phun sum tshogs pa ni/ 'di zhes pa/ snod pho ba lha'i gzhal yas khang du gsal ba ni gnas phun sum tshogs pa'o// skad ni rdzas kyi mchog sman la rang bzhin gyis gsil (bsil3drod du grub ste/nad sel ba'i mchog tu gyur cing / sems can gyi don byed pa ni ston pa'o//bdag gis ni/ nad lus zungs dri ma gsum ni 'khor ro// bshad ces pa/

254 ༄7ོkho rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogs bsgrigs/ro drug nus pa brgyad/ yon tan bcu bdun/ zhu rjes gsum gyi nad sel ba'i bya ba byed pa ni bstan pa'oku dus ni/ nad med tha mal du gnas pa dang / na ba gsos pas tshe ring / nad med dbang po gsal ba'i dus ni/dus phun sum tshogs pa'o// bya ba tshe gcig la chos nor bde ba gang dgos sgrub pa'i phyir/ las zhes sam/ de ltar thabs rang la gnas kyang kun gyis ma rtogs te/ gsang ba zhes bya'o//—gnyis pa gleng bzhi (gzhi1rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ gnas/ ston pa/ 'khor ro//dang po la gnyis te/ drang srong gi gnas zhes pa la sogs pa ston te/drang srong ni/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la/ nad rlung mkhris bad kan gsum/ 'du ba 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum gyis nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma bgos ('gos3pas drang / 'gro ba gzhan la rgyu dug gsum las bskyed pa'i 'bras bu rlung mkhris bad kan gsum gyis 'du ba 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum du gyur pa'i nyes pa drang por srong ba'i phyir ro// gi zhes pa ni/ gnas dang 'brel ba'i tshig ste/ lcags kyi ta ri zhes pa lta bu'o// gnas zhes pa rig pa'i ngo bo ma 'grub pa ste/ de yang 'byung ba'i gnas dang / bzhugs pa'i gnas te/mos pa'i dbang du sman gyi grong khyer rgya phyogs bcur yongs su ma chad pa/dug gsum dang bral te rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pas/ mig gi yul du mdzes shing lta bas mi ngoms pa'i phyir/ tha dad du ming ni lta na sdug pa zhes bya bar brtags spyobatags1pas 'byung ba lnga'i bcud 'dus pas rin po che'i rigs mi 'dra ba rnam bzhi'am lnga las rang byung lhun gyis 'grub par yod de/ shar phyogs shel dang / dbus be+e ḍūr+ya dang / nub pad+ma rā ga dang / byang in ṭa ni tu.in+d+ra nī1la dang / lho gser las grub pa dang / sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi blos gzhal ba'am dpag mi nus te/ mtha'

༄༅kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 255yas te tshad las 'das pa'i gzhal khang rang bzhin gyis gnas pa ni/ sangs rgyas sman gyi lha gtso 'khor bzhugs pa'i khang par yod do// de zhes pa/ rgyan dang 'brel ba'i tshig go/gzhal yas khang chen po de'i rgyan la gnyis te/ dang po/ nang gi rgyan ni/ sman gyi nor bu rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs pas zhes pas/ sman ni nad sel ba'i mchog tu gyur pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bu'o// rnam pa ces pa rigs mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa'o// sna tshogs ni/ sems can rnams la dgos 'dod kyi bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub par byed pa'i rgyan gyi rigs mi 'dra ba mang po rnams kyis legs par spras pa zhig yod de/ nor bu rin po che de dag gi yon tan gyis/ rlung gi nad dang / mkhris pa'i nad/ bad kan gyi nad ldan pa'i nad/ 'dus pa'i nad las gyur pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi sel bar byed pa/ ces pa ni/ 'od zer snum la gro (dro3bas/ rlung gi nad sel bar byed pa'i rin po che 'od dkar ser du 'phro ba dang / bsil la/btul (rtul3 bas khris (mkhris3 pa'i nad sel bar byed pa'i rin po che/'od zer kha dog dkar dmar ga bur dang tsan dan lta bu'i 'od 'phro ba dang /ro tsha ba dang nus pa rno bas/ bad kan gyi nad sel bar byed pa'i rin po che/'dir mdog dmar ser nyi ma'i snying po ltar 'phro ba dang / ldan pa'i nad sel bar byed pa'i rin po che'i sman bde ba bskyed par byed ces bya ba/'dir mdog kha dog ci yang 'gyur ba/ dngul chu zhun ma lta bu'i 'od 'phro ba dang / 'dus pa'i nad sel bar byed pa'i rin po che/ sman stong bde ba bskyed byed ces bya ba rtsa ba ma grub pa/ 'ja' tshon sna lnga lta bu'i 'od zer 'phro bas/ de dag la sogs pa'i nad kyi rigs su gyur pa bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la sogs pa sel bar byed pa ste/ tsha ba'i nad rnams la nus pa sel (bsil3du gyur pa/ drang tugrang3ba'i nad rnams la nus pa drod du gyur pa/ 'od zer

256 ༄༅rte rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogs bsgrigs/des gdon dang bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ dus mtha'i skad cig gcig tsam la zhi bar byed pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa ste/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po yod pa'i phyogs su/lcags mi 'byung ba'i dpe bzhin du/ sman gyi nor bu rin po che/ sa gzhi yod pa'i sa phyogs su nad kyi rigs su gyur pa mi 'byung bas/ gzhan yang khang pa gser la sogs pa du ma dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa/ sman gyi 'brug gi sgra sna tshogs dang / glog gi 'od 'gyed pa/ 'dod yon mang po'i char 'bebs pa/ gdul bya'i re ba bkong (skong1ba/ gzhal yas khang gi logs kyi rgyan yang / shar bu dang chun 'chang dang / za ram tshags la sogs pa'o// sgo bzhi rin po che/ sa gzhi la 'bru sna tshogs dang / chu yan lag brgyad ldan dang me tog la sogs pa rgyan gyi rigs sna tshogs pas legs par spras te/ gdul bya'i dgos 'dod kyi re ba thams cad yid bzhin du/ gang la gang dgos su sgrub par byed pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa yod do//gnyis pa phyi'i rgyan la bzhi ste/ lho phyogs kyi rgyan ni/ grong khyer de'i lho phyogs na/ zhes pa la sogs te/ grong khyer ni/ gong gi lta na sdug pa la gnyeg tusogs1pa'o//lho phyogs ni/ dbus kyi gtso bo zhal shar du gzigs pa'i g.yas phyogs la zer/ na zhes pa/ ri bo dang 'brel ba ste/ rin po che las grub pa'i rin khuri3bo'i mtshan 'bigs byed shin tu dro bas nyi ma'i stobs dang ldan pa'i ri bo gcig yod de/ de la yang gsum/ rang bzhin gyi ri bo ni/ sa dang chu mi 'khyags pa/ kha lho phyogs su ltas pa thams cad do// gnas kyi ri bo 'bigs byed ni/ sham bha la'i nub phyogs na yod par bshad de/ la la ni spos ngad ldan zer ro// sprul pa'i ri bo ni/ lta na sdug pa'i lho phyogs na rang byung du yod pa'o// ri de la sman ni/ pho ba'i nad sel ba'i se 'bru dang / grang rlung

༄༅kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 257sel ba'i pi pi ling dang / grang nad ma lus sel ba'i na le sham dang / shin tu nus pa rno zhing dro ba'i tsi tra ka la sogs pa/ —grang ba'i nad mtha' dag sel bar byed pa'i sman gyi rigs sna tshogs pa 'khrungs pa/ sman de dag ni ro tsha ba dang / skyur ba dang / lan tshwa ba dang ldan pa/ nus pa tsha ba dang / rno ba'i sman gyi nags tshal de la rtsa ba dang sdong po/ yal ga dang lo ma/ me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pa'i sman gyi sdong po/ sna'i yul du dri zhim pa/ mig gi yul du lta na sdug pa/ 'gro ba gang gis mthong dang thos pa'i yid du 'ong ba/ sman gyi dris khyab pa'i sa phyogs rnams su grang ba'i nad gtan nas mi 'byung ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa yod do//byang phyogs kyi rgyan ni/ grong khyer de'i byang phyogs na/ zhes pa la sogs kyis ston te ri bo'i mtshan ni gangs can zhes bya ba shin tu bsil ba zla ba chu'i stobs dang ldan pa'i ri bo de la yang gsum/ rang bzhin gyi ri bo gangs can ni kha byang la bltas shing / sa dang chu 'khyag cing rang bzhin shin tu bsil ba thams cad la bya'o// mtsho ma gros /dros3pa'i 'gram na yod pa la/ gnas kyi ri bo gangs can zhes bya'o// rgyud 'dir gsungs pa'i gangs can no// ston pa'i g.yon phyogs na yod de sprul pa'i gangs can no// ri bo de la sman gyi rigs tsan dan dang rgyas tshad sel ba'i ga bur dang / snying dang srog rtsa'i nad sel ba'i a ka ru dang / mchin mkhris tsha ba sel ba'i nim pa dang / de dag dang ro nus mtshungs pa la sogs pa'i sman tsha ba'i nad mtha' dag ma lus par sel bar byed pa'i sman gyi rigs sna tshogs pa/ ro kha ba dang mngar ba dang / nus pa bsil ba dang rtul ba'i nus pa yod pa/ sman gyi nags tshal de la yang / 'gro ba rnams kyi yid du 'ong ba sman de rnams kyis dris khyab pa'i sa phyogs rnams su tsha ba'i nad rnams gtan nas mi 'byung ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa yod do//

258 ༄༅rte rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogasabasgrigs/gsum pa grong khyer shar phyogs kyi rgyan ni grong khyer de'i shar phyogs na zhes pas/ sman gyi ri bo'i ming ni/ spos ngad ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ri bo de la yang gsum ste/ dang po rang bzhin gyi ri bo spos ngad ldan pa ni/ dri bzang po dang spos skye ba'i sa phyogs la shar du ltas pa'i sa phyogs bsil drod snyoms pa thams cad la bya'o// gsum pa sprul pa'i ri bo spos ngad ldan ni ston pa'i mdun na rab byung lhun grub tu yod pa ste/ ri de la/ 'dus pa'i nad sel ba'i a ru ra'i rang bzhin gyi sman gyis shin tu khyab pa'i nags tshal yod pa de'i rtsa bas rus pa'i 'dus nad rnams ma lus par sel ba'i nus mthu yod pa/sdong pos sha'i 'dus nad sel ba/ yal gas rtsa dang chu rus turgyusakyekyi 'dus nad sel ba/ shun pas lpags (pags3pa'i 'dus nad sel ba/ lo mas gnod tusnod3drug gi 'dus nad sel ba/ me tog gis dbang po lnga'i 'dus nad sel ba/ 'bras bus don snying la sogs pa lnga'i 'dus nad sel ba/ rtse mo la a ru ra'i rigs rnam rgyal/ 'jigs byed/ bdud rtsi sha 'thug 'phel byed skem po ste rnam pa lnga smin pa/ ro mngar bskyur(skyur1/ lan tshwa/ kha ba/bska ba/ (tsha ba )drug dang ldan pa/ nus pa bsil/ snum/ brtulaskyortul3/lci/ yang / rtsub/ tsha/ rno rnam pa brgyad dang ldan pa yod/ yon tan 'jam pa dang / lci/ grotudro3/ snum/ bstan(brtan3/ grang / bstul(rtul3/bsilam̐/ mnyen/ sla/ skam/ brgya(skya3/ tsha/ yang / brnoturno3/ tsub pa/(g.yo ba )la sogs pa bcu bdun no// sman de la yongs su rdzogs pa rlung mkhris bad kan la sogs pa nad kyi rigs su gyur pa bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi po thams cad sel ba/ sna'i yul du dri zhim pa/ mig gi yul du lta na sdug pa/sems can rnams kyis mthong ba dang / thos pas dang spro zhing yid du 'ong ba/sman gyi dris khyab pa rnams su nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi gtan nas 'byung mi nus pa yod do//

༄zarte rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 259nub phyogs kyi rgyan ni/ grong khyer de'i nub phyogs na/ zhes pas ston te/sman gyi ri bo ma la ya zhes bya ba rgya mtsho'i 'gram na ri bo snang ba yod de/ de la yang gsum yod de/ rang bzhin gyi ri dang / gnas kyi ri dang / sprul pa'o//dang po rang bzhin gyi ri bo ni sman sna tshogs pa 'khrungs pa dang / kha nub phyogs su ltas pa/ sa phyogs bsil grod (drod1snyoms shing nyams dga' ba rnams la bya'o// gnas kyi ri bo ni/ nub phyogs rgya mtsho'i ngos na yod pa'o//sprul pa'i ri bo 'dir bshad pa ni/ ston pa'i sku rgyab na/ rang byung na yod pa'o/ ri bo de la sman gyi rigs bzang po dzā ti sug smel ka kha lo (ko la1/bcu (cu1gang li shi gur kum ste bzang drug gi sman rnams sa phyogs der 'khrungs pa/ nad kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad ma lus par sel bar byed pa'i sman/ gzhan yang / bcong (cong3zhi pho gcong skyicong3ni/ rta so bcag pa 'dra ba kha dog shel lta bu bzang po'i rigs te/ na so dar mas brten tubastenakye'aju ba dka'/ mo gcong (cong3'dog (mdog3dkar la tsod ru'am/ 'khyag pa'i zar bu ltar g.ya' 'am brag gi srubs su 'bur 'bur du skyes te nus pa rtsi dngos dang mtshungs so// ma ning gcong (congakazhi ni/gangs sam g.ya' brag mtshams su ba'i nu ma lta bur skye/ la las dkar po gangs thigs zer/ nad ma lus zhi bar byed/ nus pa ni sdud tubadud3rtsi mngos (dngos3dang mtshungs so// bcong tucong1zhi ser po ni/ g.ya' 'am brag gi srubs su chags/ zho'am spris ma'am sbu (lbukyeb chags pa 'dra/ ming ni ser po g.ya' lce zer/ shin tu chags pa skye bas dka' thub byed pas bza' mi rung / mkhal nad can la bdud rtsi 'dra/ gcong (cong1zhi dkar po ni/ chu tshan sman chu yod sar 'byung / dkar po gangs thigs zhes bya ste/dkar sob gnyen (mnyenakyel 'bol ba ste/ bcud len dag tu ster bar bya/bad kan dmug skyosrug3ser skya bo sel/ mgo chag dma' ba'i gnyen po yin/

260 ༄zakho rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogs bsgrigs/gcong (cong3zhi rigs lnga'i dbye ba ni/ kho bos rang gzor tubazo1byas pa ma yin te/ mdo rgyud rin po che'i phreng ba las btus pa'o// de ltar rigs lnga dang / brag zhun gyi rigs rnam pa lnga/ brag kha dog rigs lnga las byung ba la/brag zhun rigs lngar phye bas/ rigs lngar 'dod de/ g.yu thog bkra shis mgon po'i zhal nas/ brag zhun rigs lnga la sogs pa/ brag mdog rigs lnga'i tshul gyis shes so// zhes gsungs so// de rnams kyang / ro kha mngar skyur tsha bska ba ste ldan pa'i ros nad gang yang sel ba khyad par mtshon pa'i tsha ba sel ba dang ldan pa'i nus pa yod do// de ltar gcong (cong1zhi dang brag zhun gnyis ni 'byung ba'i bcud 'dus pa'i srid pa'i byang sems dkar dmar yin pa bdud rtsi dri med shel gyi bum pa'i rgyud las gsungs te/ nad kyang ldan 'dus kun sel ba'i nus pa rang byung du yod do// sman chu rnams kyi rigs ni/ rlung sel ba'i sman chu/ ro mngar chu ldog (mdog3dang nya lcibs sngo/ nus pa ci (lci1la 'jam/ kha nub tu ltas te 'bab/ rlung rkyang pa sel/mkhris pa sel ba'i sman chu nya lcibs chu mdog ser/ ro kha nus pa bla tul(sla rtul3/ kha byang la bltas nas 'bab/ bad kan sel ba'i sman chu/ kha lho la bltas nas 'bab/ chu mdog nya lcibs dkar/ ro tsha ba lan tshwa yod pa nus pa tsub cing rno ba'o// 'di nyid kyi mchan las kyang rlung sel ba'i ro lnga (sngo3la mngar/ mkhris pa sel ba kha ser/ bad kan sel ba skya bskyur(skyur1/ khrag sel bas dmar dka' (bska3 chu ser sel ba smug 'khyitutsha1/ zhes pas/ldan 'dus kyi nad sel ba'i sman chu ni gong ma ltar 'dres ('gres3pa las shes par bya'o// mdog lnga gang yin dang bzang ngan rig pas lhag (brtag3par bya'o// chu tshan rigs lnga ni/ rdo sol chu tshan/ mu zi chu tshan/ bsto (rdo3chu chu tshan/ mu 'jang (zi3chu tshan/ rdo zho chu tshan dang lnga'i brtag thabs dang bzang ngan gyi dbye ba ni rdo sol dang / mu zi chu gseb na yod pa dang / reg

༄༅kho rgyugakyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 261bya tsha grang las shes par bya'o// nad grang rlung dang / chu ser bad kan skya bo sel ba 'dod pa phyogs de na gcong (cong3zhi brag zhun sman chu chu tshan rigs lnga tshang zhing / ldan pa'i ri bo gcig yod do// sa phyogs thams cad kyang /gur gum gyi spang ri dang dri yang sman dang / spos kyi ngad dang ldan pa dri zhim pa/sa phyogs de'i brag thams cad la yang ba nu dang / ldong ros dang / khab len dang / sbal rgyab dang / ti tsha dang / rdo rgyus la sogs pa/ rdo'i sman gyi rigs su gyur pa rnams tshang zhing / tshwa sna'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad yang tshang bar yod do// sman gyi nags tshal rnams kyi rtse mo la/ bya'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dug nad sel ba'i sman lus la yodapa'i rma bya dang / sha za'i rigs shang shang dang smra mkhan mi'i skad shes pa'i ni tso la sogs pa/ bya'i skad sna tshogs pa rna ba'i yul du skad snyan par sgrog pa/ gzhan yang srog chags kyi rigs 'gi hang (gi wang1lus la 'dzin pa'i glang po che dang /mchin tshad sel zhing rtsa kha sdom rma kha gso ba'i sman dom mkhris 'dzin pa'i dom dang / mkhal nad gnyan srin gyi nad sel ba'i sman gla rtsi lus la 'dzin pa'i gla ba la sogs pa'i srog chags kyi rigs sna tshogs pa sman bzang po lus la 'dzin pa'i sems can rnams tshang bar ri de'i stod smad na gnas pa yod de/mdor na phyogs de na sman gyi rigs su gyur pa kun ma 'khrungs pa med pa'am sna tshogs pa la gang yang ma tshang ba med pa'i rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa du mas legs par spras pa'o// de lta bu'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa rgyan sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa de ni/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje 'gro ba sems can gyi don la sprul pa'i gnas te/ de na gnas pa'i srog chags rnams kyang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sha stag gdul bya gang la gang 'dul du sprul nas nad kyi sdug bsngal las thar bar bya ba'i phyir/ sman bzang po lus la 'dzin pa'i sems can sna tshogs par sprul pa'o/ gnas de ni sa phyogs de na yod ces

262 ༄tshorte rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogs bsgrigs/sems can gyi blos mtshon du med de/ sprul pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro//'di la rdza ye shes gzungs dang / sta ga bdun pa ni spyon na yod par 'dod/chos mngon pa'i lugs kyis/ ri rab kyi lcog bzhi pa'i dbus na yod par 'dod de/ de ni sum cu rtsa gsum brgya byin gyi pho brang yin la/ sprul pa'i gnas lta na sdug ni 'di na yod skye bo'i blos mtshon par ga la nus te/ sprul pa'i gnas la nges pa med pa'i phyir ro//ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ gzhal yas khang de'i dbus na/ nor bu rin po che be+e ḍūr+ya'i khri la zhes pas ston te/ gzhal yas khang chen po de'i dbus kyi lte ba na/ yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i nor bu rin po che kha dog mthing ka la be+e ḍūr+ya las grub pa'i khri rin po che'i ka ba brgyad kyis steg (btegs3pa/ phyogs bzhi nas rin po che'i bsdung skyogadung3gis bres pa/bsdung (gdung3'go snol mar yod pa/ rad rna'i (rat+na'i3bang mdzod brgya dang ldan pa/ chu yan lag brgyad kyi rdzing bu phyogs re re na bdun bdun yod pa/ rdzing bu de dag la me tog pad+ma bdun bdun 'khrungs pa/ 'dod yon gyi lha mo brgyad/ mchod yon sna tshogs thogs pas mchod pa byed pa/ khri smig (mig1 brgyad na/ mi 'jig ('jigs1 pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i brtags (rtagasakasu seng ge chen po brgyad la phyir bltas la/ dbus kyi pad sdong la 'jug pa gcig tu 'khril te brten pa/ pad+matsāsdong po ge sar kha phye ba'i steng na/nyi zla pad+ma sum brtsegs kyi gdan la/ brgyud (rgyud3sde bzhi dang theg pa sna tshogs kyi chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bdud bzhi ngang gis bcom nas legs pa'i yon tan drug dang ldan te 'khor ba'i mi rtag mya ngan gyi mtha' nyid las 'das nas/ thugs rje 'gro ba sems can rnams kyi nad rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas pa gsal (bsal3te/ chos dang srogs ( srog1'tsho bar mdzad pas sems can kun la sman pa'i phyir sman pa zhes bya'o// sman pa rnams kyi mchog

༄7kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 263tu gyur pa'am/ nad kyi sgra (dgra1las rgyal bas na rgyal po zhes bya'o// sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' las/ sa gsum gyis khyad du 'phags te/spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i phyir nas (na3rgyal po zhes bya'o// ston pa de'i mtshan ni sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po zhes bya'o// sku'i cha lugs ni/ sku lnga lhun grub tu bzhugs te/ longs spyod kyi dbang gis skabs 'dir sku'i cha lugs ni/ zhabs rdzogs pa'i dkyil mo dkrung du bzhugs pa/ sku mdog mthing ka phyag g.yas na skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas a ru ra dang rdo rje/ g.yon bdud rtsi lhung bzed bsnams pa/ na bza' rnam sbyar dang chos gos gsol ba/mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ sku'i ba spu'i bu ga re re nas/ 'od zer kha dog brgya stong phyogs bcur 'phro ba/sems can rnams kyi ma rig pa las byung ba'i dug gsum gyi nad thams cad zhi bar byas nas/ rgyal ba rnams mnyes par byed pa/ gsung ni/ skye med don gyi gsung dang / dgongs pa brda'i gsung / mngon pa tshig gi gsung dang /dbyer med rdo rje'i gsung / rig pa byin rlabs kyi gsung dang lnga/ lhun grub tu lnga yang / skabs 'dir sprul sku mngon pa'i tshig gsung / dbyangs kyi yan lag sum brgya drug cus rgyud 'di nyid ston to// thugs lnga lhun grub tu gnas te/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' bas/ sman gyi rgyal po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so//'khor phun sum tshogs pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan te/ ston pa de la 'khor ni zhes pas ston te/ ston pa sangs rgyas sman bla de la 'khor gyi rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi yod de/ lha'i 'khor dang / drang srong gi 'khor dang / phyi pa mu stegs byed pa yi 'khor dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i 'khor la sogs pa rigs bzhi ston pa de la yongs su skor ba ste/ mdor bstan to// rgyas par bshad pa ni/ gang zhe na/ zhes pas (du)ma go ba ston pa ste/ lha'i 'khor la

264 ༄zarte rgyudakyi 'grelapa phyogasabasgrigs/'di lta ste/ zhes pa la sogs rgyas par ston te/ de la bzhi ste/ lha'i sman pa laskye ba dgu'i bar drang srong gis lus blangs nas gso dpyad kyi bdag por gyur pa dang / lha'i sman pas kar (skarakyem bra nye la kyes (skyes3pas ming thad kar (tha skarakyedang / lha'i sman pa dbang po brgya byin dang / lha'i 'khor 'tsho byed lha mo bdud rtsi ma la sogs pa zhes pas/ gtso bo bzhi dang / gzhan yang lha'i 'khor mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ston pa thabs cig tu bzhugs so// gzhan yang drang srong gi 'khor ni 'di lta ste/ zhes pas/ 'khor gyi don go bar byed pa'i tshig yin te/ 'og ma kun la'ang 'dres ('gres3su shes par bya'o// drang srong chen po rgyun po shes kyi bu dang / zhes pas/ drang srong gi 'khor gtso bo brgyad dang / mu stegs kyi mes po tshangs pa dang / zhes pas/phyi pa'i 'khor gtso bo lnga/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / zhes pas/ nang pa'i 'khor gtso bo lnga ste/ mtshan du ldan pa nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / mang po dang thabs cig tu/ zhes pas/ 'khor gyi tshogs mang po gang zag gi blos dpag gis mi langs pa dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so// gsung cig la 'khor gyi go tshul gyi lung bden bzhi byung tshul ni/ de'i tshe de'i dus na/ zhes pa la sogs pas ston te/ ston 'khor gnas gcig tu thabs cig tu bzhugs pa'i dus de'i tshe de'i dus na ston pas zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshig gis rnam grangs gcig la 'khor gyi rigs rnam pa bzhis so sor rang gi ston pa'i cha lugs dang / gsung gis rang rang gi chos lugs ston cing so so'i skad du go bar blo spros pa zad do// rgyud 'di drang srong gi lugs su ngos bzung ba ni/ 'di ni rangagi lus ngag yid ces pa la sogs pas ston te/ rgyud 'di drang srong gi lāgs su rtogs te/ 'di ni rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rlung mkhris bad kan gyi nyes pa med par drang por bzhag nad nyes pa'i skyon med pas drang /gzhan yang rlung mkhris bad kan gyi nyes pa ma snyoms par drang por snyoms par

༄༅kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 265byed pas drang srong / de lta bu'i don rgyas par rgyud 'di nyid nas ston pa'i phyir na/ drang srong gi lugs so// zhes ming du btags pa yin zhes —bya 'o/sdud pa po phun sum tshogs pa ni drang srong yid las skyes so// de'i bstan pa'i rgyud ni don rnams dang po zhu bar byed/ bar du rgyas par byed/ tha mar don rnams bsdud (sdudakapar byed de/ 'khor gyi gtso bo de/ 'khor phun sum tshogs par rtogs tugatogs3so// dum+mu phun sum tshogs pa ni ston pa 'khor rnams gnas gcig tu tshogs pa'i dus so// bstan pa ni/ ston pa'i thugs la lnga ste/ gsung gcig la/ 'khor gyi tshul gyis lung bden bzhi byung ba de'o//le'u'i (mtshan) ni/ bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las/ zhes pa brgyud (rgyud3kyi mtshan te/ mtshan gyi de la rtsa brgyud (rgyud3kyi dbang du le'u drug yod pa'am/ le'u dang po mngos (dngos3kyi mtshan ni phun sum tshogs pa lnga tshogs pa las/ gleng bzhi tugazhika'abyung ba'i rgyur nges pa'o// de ci'i phyir na/ ston gnas la sogs gang rung /gcig ma tshang yang chos 'byung ba'i bsgyur (rgyur3mi rung ba'i phyir ro// gleng bzhi (gzhi3zhes pa ni sam (saṃkyeskṛ ta'i sgra las ni brda zhes pa/ 'byung ba nges pa zhes pa ste/ sa ri pa ta la na/ le'u zhes bya ste/ gzhung rgyas pa de mtshams bcad pa ste/ sdud pa'i phyir gos kyi gong ma lta bu'am/ dang po zhes pa ni/sngon na gzhan med pa'am/ thog mar smos pa'o//le'u gnyis pa/ gleng slong rnam grangs rnam par bkod pa/spyi don gnyis pa gleng slong gi swe'u thastan pa la gnyis te/ gzhung dang mtshan ni/ dang po la lnga snye/ponyang nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa las rtsa rgyud 'chad pa'o// stonadzo ngakro galo tshul ni/ de'i tshe de'i dusan zhes pa nas/ mdun gyi bar

266 ༄zakho rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogs bsgrigs/snang la zhes pa mdun gyis ston te/ gong du gleng bzhi (gzhi1phun sumatsogs pa de'i tshe/ gleng slong bar byed pa'i dus gzhan du bar ma chad pa'i dus de trem na/ rgyud don ston pa bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams kyi nad gsos nas tshe srog 'tsho bar mdzad pa sman pa'i rgyal po/ sku mdog be+e ḍūr+ya'i mdog lta bu/rī nad kyi dgra lasatshorgyal ba'i phyir rgyal po lta bu'o// nad nyes pas phye ba brgya dang gcig gtso bos phye ba/ rigs kyis phye ba/ gnas rnams kyis phye ba brgya dang gcig bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la sogs pa thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i phyir na ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan sman gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i don dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig la sems can kun la snyoms par bzhugs so//ston pas ting nge 'dzin de la snyoms par bzhugs ma thag tu/ ston pa de nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po dang dmar po dang ser po dang mthing ka la sogs pa kha dog rigs mi 'dra ba brgya stong du ma grangs med pa steng mgo ('og3shar lho nub byang mtshams bzhi dang phyogs bcur 'phros pas sems can 'gro ba rigs drug la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa las byung ba'i dug gsum gyi nad kyi nyes pa'i skyon sangs rgyas kyi thugs rjes thams cad la ma lus par skyon med bsal te/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang sems gyi sems kun gzhi byang chub sems su bdag gcig par 'brel ba'i phyir ro// skyon med par rig cing rtogs pas/ gsal zhes bya'o/ji ste gsal na 'od zer ni ston pa'i thugs ka nas zhes pas/ sems can thams cad kyi sems zhes pas/ de nyid dbyer med pa'i phyir ro// de ltar yang sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med pas/ lam gyis bcod tugacod3du ga la yod/ ces so// de ltar donasadacer med pa zhig yin kyang / ma rig pa las byung ba'i zhes pas/ sems can rnams rkyagyu lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas/ rang gi sems nyid sangs rgyas yin par ngo ma shes sri rteri rkyen kun tu

༄7kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 26 7btags pa'i rig pas/ sred pa la phyin ci log tu btags te/ bdag dang bdag gis gzhan du bzung bas 'phrul ('khrul3te/ khams gsum du 'khor zhing brgyud (rgyud3drug tu 'khyams so// de ltar 'khyams pa rang ci yin zhes na/ chos mngon pa las/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis 'byung ba bzhi rnams mtha' dag ni sdug bsngal ba'o// zhes so// de lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mtha' dag ni las byung ba'i 'bras bu dug gsum gyis dus thams cad du 'byung ba de yi 'bras bu/ rlung mkhris bad kan gyi nad yan lag dang bcas pa thams cad zhi bar byas nas/ gdul bya sems can rnams bde ba yang dag pa'i lam la bkod de/ slar 'od zer de dag ston pa'i thugs khar 'dus pa'i byin brlabs las sprul pa ni rang rgyud pa ma yin te/ med pa las rgyun du 'byung bas sprul pa'o// 'di zhes pa rgyud kyi tshig gis ston pa mtshan ni drang srong rig pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba zhig/ sangs rgyas sku lnga lhun grub de'i mthu rang rig pa'i ye shes las sprul te/ sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu zhig ston pa'am mdun phyogs kyi bar snang la bzhugs nas zhes pas ston te/gnyis pa ston pas 'khor la mdun bsus pa la nad tshegs su gnyis te/mdo rgyas so// dang po ni drang srong gi zhes so// lus ngag yid gsum la nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pas/ rang nyid drang por gnas la gzhan gyi nyes pa drongs (drang1zhing sems can gyi don byed nus pa'i 'khor dang / phyi pa'i 'khor dang / lha'i 'khor dang / nang pa'i 'khor dang / drang srong gi 'khor dang (phal )mo che rnams la 'go ltamago1nas 'byung ba'i tshig don 'di bkar zhes bya bas mdun bsu ba'o// ci'i phyir 'dun gsum (mdun bsu1dgos zhes bya ba na/ 'khor rnams kyis ston pa'i gzi brjid ma bzod de/ zil gyis gnan (mnan3nas zhu ma bzod pa'i phyir/ ston pas mdun bsu ba rgyas

268 sa༅rte rgyudakyi 'grel pa phyogasabasgrigs/pa ni/ kyai grogs po dag shes par gyis shig ces pas ston te/ kye'o 'khor rnams la 'bod pa'i sgra'o// grogs po zhes pas khengs pa skyung pa dang / drang srong tsam du snyam pa las dgongs pa'o// dag ces pa ni/ bslab pa'i gnas dang slob pa'i dgongs 'grel sgo nas 'byung ba ltar shes par gyis shig de la drangasrong byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bslab pa'i gnas ni/ mi na tha mal du gnas par 'dod pa dang / rang bzhin gyi lus la nad kyis zin pa'i na ba rnams legs par gso bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis byang chub sems dpa' gang yul su yang rung ba shes rab blo dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig gis/gso ba rig pa'i man ngag don zab la rgya che ba'i man ngag 'di lta bu la bslab par bya'o// de bslab pa la dgos pa ci yod snyam na/ dus spyod rgyun spyod gnas skabs kyi spyod pa dang / zas dang sman spyad tudapyad3kyi rim pa phan gnod shes pas rang gzhan gyi lus mi na bar gnas pa dang / na ba'i lus gso ba'i dgos pa yod do// mi na bar gnas par bya ba dang / na ba gso ba la dgos pa ci yod zhes na/ tshe ring du gnas par 'dod pa'i gang zag rnams kyis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o// zhes pas/ tshe ring thub pa'i dgos pa yod/ tshe ring bar gnas pa la dgos pa ci yod zhe na/'di phyi gnyis su bde bar byed pa'i chos dang / tshe 'dir bde ba nor longs spyod dang / dbang dang dga' bde 'byung la chos la spyad pas gnas skabs kyi mthar thug bde ba chen po 'grub par yid la 'dod pa'i gang zag rnams kyis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag 'di lta bu la thos bsam gyi shes rab kyis bslab par bya'o// zhes pas/ bde ba khyad par can de lta bu thob pas dgos pa shin tu che'o// drang srong byang chub sems dpa' de'i rigs can/ 'gro ba gang zhig nad kyi sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las grol bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o// 'gro ba sems can gzhan ma

༄7kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 269rnams kyi spyi bos bdag nyid nor bu ltar spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur bar 'dod pa'i gzhan phan gyi blo yod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la thos bsam gyi shes rab brtson 'grus kyis 'bad de bslab par bya'o// ston pa bcom ldan 'das 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po des gso rig gsung de skad ces zhal nas gsungs te/ bka' bstsal ba dang / 'khor gyi drang srong phal mo che rnams kyis zhu ba ma spobasawā la/ zhu ba po sprul tshul ni/ de'i tshe de'i dus na/ zhes tshig lngas ston te/ bka' bstsal pa/ 'khor la mdun bsu ba de'i tshe 'khor rnams kyis zhu ba ma spobs pa de'i dus na mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa'i drang srong rig pa'i ye shes/ be+e ḍūr+ya'i thugs kyi sprul pa des/sems can phal mo che rnams nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyis bzir (gzir1ba rnams la/ 'khor gyi drang srong rnams la brtse ba'i thugs rjes skyed de/ bstan pa rgyas par bya ba'i phyir ram/ 'gro ba'i don mthar phyin par bya ba'i phyir du ston pa bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po de nyid kyi ljags kyi dbang po las 'od zer kha dog grangs brgya stong du ma zhes pa grangs med pa phyogs bcur phro phro tu'aphro 'phroka'aphros pas/ phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyi ngag gi nyes pa'i skyon/ rdzun dang ngag 'khyal pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa'i skyon thams cad ma lus gsal(bsal3/ nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang / gdon stong phrag brgyad cu la sogs thams cad zhi bar byas nas 'gro ba'i don rdzogs par mdzad nas/ slar yang 'od zer de dag ston pa'i ljags la 'dus pa las ston pa de nyid kyi gsung gi sprul pa'i mtshan ni drang srong yid las skyes zhes bya ba sku mtshan gyi me tog la/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i 'bras bus brgyan pa zhes rang byung du byung ste/ zhu ba po'i tshul gyis gus pas btud de/ dri ba dris pa ni/ston pa la phyag dang zhes pa'i tshig brgyad kyis ston te/ brgyud turgyud3'chad pa po'i ston pas sangs rgyas sman bla'i thugs kyi ngo bo rang snang du ma 'gags

270 ༄༅kho rgyud kyi'igrel pa phyogs bsgrigs/bar shar bas/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum du/ bslab pa'i gnas drug rang gsal du rig pa'i ye shes kyis thogs med du rig pa'i phyir rig pa'i ye shes te/ ston pa de la zhu ba po/ drang srong yid las skyes kyis gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag dang skor ba grangs med pa byas te/ mchod pa sna tshogs pas mchod na/ston pa la zhu don/ zhu ba la zhum pa med pas/ seng ge'i blta stangs kyis ston pa'i mdun na 'dug ste/ ston pa'i 'khor gyi drang srong phal mo che rnams kyis zhu bar ma spobs rnams kyi don du zhu ba'i tshig ni 'di skad ces zhu ba gsol to//kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags/ zhes pas ston pa la bos te/dgongs gcig par zhus pa'o// ston pa'i ston pa ni be+e ḍūr+ya yin la/ brgyud (rgyud3dngos su 'chad pa'i ston pa ni rig pa'i ye shes des gong du bstan pa ltar gso ba rig pa la bslabs par zhus pas/ bdag gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa 'grub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la bslab par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa de la/ bdag la sogs pa rnams kyis ji ltar du gso ba rig pa'i man ngag gang dang ji lta bu la bslab par bya'o// zhes drang srong yid las skyes kyis ston pa la gong gi tshig de skad ces zhus pa dang /zhes pas ston to// skabs la gleng du bslangs pa la gsum ste/ dang po 'od ni mthu las sprul pa'i drang srong zhes pas ston to// ston pa'i mthu las rtsa rgyud 'chad pa'i ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'go tumago1nas byung ba 'di skad ces gsungs so// kyai zhes yid las skyes la sogs pa'i drang srong chen po rnams la bos te/ bya sla tshegs chung don che ba'i phyir/ gso ba rig pa'i man ngag gis sangs rgyas kyi bka' lung yang dag pa tshang zhing 'brel ba ni rgyud la bslab par bya'o// gso ba rig pa dgos pa'i cha lag tshang bar ston pas yan lag la bslab par bya'o// gso dpyad thams cad kyi don ma lus par 'dus pas de'i bdag po sman pa'i bslab bya yin pas gnas la bslab

༄7/rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyudadon gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 271par bya'o// gso bya gso byed kyi dpe don ma 'dres pa dang / nad gso bar byed pa'i sde tshan la mtshams phyed pas na/ skabs la bslab par bya'o// de dag gi lag len rnams mdor bsdus te ston pas na mdo la bslab par bya'o//bye brag gi rnam grangs so sor phye ste/ gzhung tshom bur bcos pa dang / le'u la bslab par bya'o// zhes mdor bstan du gsungs pa dang zhes bslab byar don drug tu gsungs pa'o//gnyis pa rgyas pa la gnyis/ bslab par zhus pa dang lan no//bslab par zhus pa ni/ drang srong gi yid las skyes zhes pas/ drang srong yid las skyes kyi tshig 'di skad ces ston pa la gsol to// kye zhes pas brgyad pa ston pa la 'bod de/ gsan cig pa lags te/ gso ba rig pa'i man ngag la/ bslab bya drug tu gsungs pa'i gang la ji ltar bdag gis bslab par bgyi zhes dris pa'o//lan la drug las dang po rgyud la bslab pa ni/ ston pas bka' bstsal ba/zhes pas drang srong yid las skyes la 'di skad ces ston pas bka' bstsal ba/kyai drang srong na/ rgyud 'byung bar byed pa'i dri ba la rag lus pas/ dri ba'i spobs pa dang ldan pas chen po'o// nyon cig ni snyan gsan phebs ('be+ebs3pa'am/ ma yengs par gyis shig pa ste/ de yang kun byed las/ sems dpa' chen po/ yid rna ba'i dbang po'i sar ltos (gtod3cig rna dbang sgra la/ ngas (nges3don sgrar bshad kyis/ zhes pas dri ba'i spobs pa dang ldan pas chen po/ nyon cig pa ni snyan gsan 'bebs pa'am ma yengs par gyis shig pa ste/ de yang kun byed las/ sems dpa' chen po sgra don mtshon par byed pas/ sems ma yengs par nyon cig pa'o// de yang sdud pa po ni/ ston pa'i gsung gi ngo bo yin pas/ yengs pa mi mnga' na yang / rjes 'jug lam pa'i drang srong rnams pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis/ nyan pa ltar byas

272 ༄༅kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogs bsgrigs/kyang sgra thos sgras su song ste tshig mi zin/ tshig mi zin pas don mi go/ tshig don gnyis ka ma zin na/ 'chad pa pos bzab (gzab1kyang ngag sgron du song ste dus lta bas ma yengs pa gal che'o// bslab bya'i rnam grangs drug tu yod kyang thog mar brgyud (rgyud3sde rigs bzhi la bslab par bya'o// de yang gang zhes na 'di lta ste/ dbang po rab la rtsa rgyud dang / 'bring la bshad pa'i rgyud dang / dbang po tha ma'i don du man ngag rgyud dang / shin tu blo dman pa'i don du phyi ma'i rgyud dang / de ltar brgyud skyorgyud1sde bzhi ni rnam grangs brgyud (rgyud1bzhir shes par bya'o// gtan tshigs ni gso ba po blo rab 'bring tha ma dang sbyar ro// de yang phyi ma las rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud man ngag brgyud (rgyud1dang gsum/ dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i don du gsungs lags zhes pas gsal lo// de yang blo dang dbang po rab kyi don du/ gso spyad tudapyad3thams cad kyi don dang rtsa ba bsdus pa rtsa brgyud (rgyudakadu bsdus nas/ mdo nas (gnas3rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan/ blo 'bring la bshad pa'i brgyud (rgyud3bstan/ blo tha ma'i don du rtsa brgyud (rgyud3bshad rgyud kyi lag len dmar khrid du ston par byed pa la/ man ngag rgyud kyi shin tu rgyas par bstan pa'o// de yang mang na ma bcogs (lcogs1pas blo zhan pa rnams kyi don du/ brtag thabs rtsa dang chur bsdus/ lag len spyad (dpyad3du bstan nas lag len du hril gyis bsdus pa/ brgyud (rgyud1phyi ma bstan pas na brgyud (rgyud3bzhir grangs go rim nges te/ grangs bzhi go rim blo'i rim pas rgyas bsdus su bstan no//gnyis pa (yan lag3la bslab pa ni/ yan lag brgyad pa zhes pas ston/de yang gang zhes na 'di ltar bshad pa ste/ spyir gso ba'i yan lag lus dang /bye brag gso bya byis pa mo nad gdon gyis zin pa'i lus gso ba/ mtshon gyis zin pa'i lus gso ba/ dug nad gso ba/ 'byung po stobs nyams pa/

༄7kho rgyud kyi 'a grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 273brgas turgas1pa gso ba khu ba zad slugs (rlugs1te/ 'bral ('phral3du lus kyi stobs nyams nas 'dod pa spyod mi nus pa ro rtsa (tsa3bar byed pa dang /spyir gso ba dang / bye brag tu gso ba'i gnas thams cad yan lag brgyad du 'dus par drang srong rnams kyis shes par bya'o// de la bzhi ste/ brgyad kyi rgyu mtshan bstan pa dang / grangs nges pa/ go rim nges pa/ yan lag brgyad kyi lhag pa'o// dang po yan lag ni dgos pa'i cha lag dang ldan pa ste/ brgyad pa ni grangs nges pa'o// de yang rgyu'i yan lag dang grogs kyi yan lag cha shas kyi yan lag ngohobo'i yan lag las 'di ni ngo so'i (bo'i3yan lag ste/ gso bya'i yul brgyad yod pa las/ gso thabs kyi yan lag brgyad du bstan pa'i phyir ro// gang gi yan lag yin na/ gso ba rig pa'i yan lag yin te/dgongs pa la ltos pa'i phyir ro// dper na gso ba rig pa ni mi gcig gis yul kha brgyad dam/ lung pa gcig gi mdo na/ phu ma dgo' (dgu'am3brgyad 'dzin dgos pa ltar/ lus gso ba'i yan lag tu/ byis pa la sogs bye brag bdun 'dus pa ni mi gcig po de la/ lung pa gcig kyang yul bdun nam/ lung pa'i yan lag bdun 'jun pa la/ bye brag so sor bskos pa'i mi bdun jo bo gcig gis bskos pa ltar ram/ yang la las bzhed pa'i pha mi cha brgyad ldan pa gcig gis sum cha brgyad 'dzin pa la bu dgos pas bu rtsalatubatsal3/ / bud med kyang yul kha brgyad ma zin te bu rtsal (btsalakabs bu bdun byung ste yul kha brgyad bzung bas/ de bzhin du lus gso ba des byis pa la sogs yan lag bdun po spyir lus gso ba tsam du khyab pa la/ bye brag tu ma khyab pas/ lus kyi bye brag tu gso ba bdun dgos pa 'byung ngo // de yang tsha bo bdun po bu'i yan lag yin la/ bu yang pha'i yan lag yin pa la/ pha des nga la bu tsha'i yan lag brgyad yod zer ba ltar/ byis pa la sogs bdun po lus gso ba'i yan lag yin la/ lus gso ba rig pa'i yan lag yin pas/

274 ༄༅kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogasabasgrigs/gso ba rig pa yan lag brgyad du 'byung ba'i phyir ngo bo'i yan lag go/grangs nges pa gsum ste/ mang ba dang nyung bar tog (dogs1pa'i mtha' dgag pa dang / grangs nges pa kho nar ldan pa dang / gzhan gyi rgol ba dgag pa'o// dang po byis pa dang rgas pa la gso dgos na/ dar ma la yang dgos/bud med kyi nad la gso na skyes pa'i nad bco brgyad la'ang dgos te/ bcur 'gyur la/ 'dir ma tshang zer na phyir lus gso ba de yan lag bdun la khyab kyang khyad par du skyes pa dang dar ma'i lus gtso bor byas pa ste/ de gnyis kyi nad thams cad lus gso bar ma 'dus pa med cing / lus phyi nang bar gsum gyi nad gso ba ston pa'i phyir ro// nyung bar rtogs pa ni/ yan lag brgyad mi dgos te/ thams cad lus gso ba las med/ lus gso na des chog pa'i phyir dang / nad dang nad med kyi bya ba ma lus pa med pa'i phyir dang /rang bzhin gnas pa dang / glo bur du rkyen gyi nad gnyis su ma 'dus pa med pa'i phyir ro// zhes na 'dus pa de rnams su 'dus kyang / de rnams la dgos pa'i yan lag dang mi ldan te/ brgyad du nges so// ci'i phyir nges na/ lus zhesakhya ba nad dang lus zungs dri ma gsum dang ldan pa yin pas/ de dag 'phel zad du gyur pa gso ba yin pas/ lus gso ba'i yan lag ces bya ste/yan lag bdun la phyir khyab pa bu des tsha bo bdun la khyab la ltar ro// de yang bu des yan lag bdun la khyab pa bzhin du/ lus spyi tsam du gso ba des bye brag tu gso ba la khyab ste/ bye brag byis pa'i lus gso ba la sogs/ yan lag bdun ldan du dgos byung ba des/ lus gso ba de las khyad par byis pa'i lus la na nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa gso ba la byis pa gso ba'i yan lag dgos par byung / de bzhin bud med la mo nad bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi yod pa las/ mo nad gso ba'i/ de bzhin gdon dang / mtshon dang dug byung ba'i lus dang / de gsum gso ba'i yan lag lus de la rgas nas 'byung ba'i stobs nyams te/

sku'i+okho rgyud kyi 'grel pa rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 275'dod pa spyod mi nus pa la rgas pa gso ba dang ro tsa dgos par byung ba'i brgyad du nges so// dper na yul kha brgyad du/ mi kha skyis (shas1so nam dang / phugs (phyugs3skyong pa dang / chos bshad pa/ sman rtsis/ bon chog rim 'gro tugro3/ bzo rigs (rig1la sogs byed pa bzhin no// gzhamādang 'gal ba dgag pa ni/ bstan bcos brgyad pa nas/ lus btod (stod3gtso bar bshad pa la/ 'dir mo nad yong ba 'gal zhes na/ lus stod gso dgos na smad la yang dgos te/ smad la ltod (stod3ma 'dus pa'i phyir dang /mo nad de brgyad pa'i khongs su ma 'dus te/ gso bya yul gyi nad drug kyang /gso thabs kyi cha lag ma tshang ba'i phyir ro// de gso thabs mtshon gyi skyabs na yod do zhe na/ dze 'o na rgyas bshad la mdor bstanatshogyi rtsa ba ma zin pa gal ('gal3te/ mdor bstanartsile'u dang po las/ lus dang byis pa gdon lus gtad (stodakyedoka 5 mtshon dang mche ba rgas pa ro tsa ba/ zhes mo nad bshad pas/ mtshon gso ba dang mo nad gnyis la mtshungs pa'i phyir ro// mo nad lus gso bar 'dus pas mi 'gal zhe na/ 'o na mtshon gso ba'i skabs su bstan pa dang 'gal la/ byis pa dang dgos pa gso ba la'ang lus gso bar 'dus pas/ yan lag drug tu thal/ de gnyis ma 'dus na mo nad 'dus pa'ang 'gal te/ rgan byis gnyis ma 'dus med thal/ yang bud med la ro tsa ba med pas/ ro tsa ba'i skabs su 'jug pa 'gal zhes na/ bud med ro tsa ba byar med kyang rtsa ba bu 'dod pa'i yan lag dgos pa dang / skyes pa'i khu ba gso ba dang / bud med kyi bu gso ba gnyis ka nad gzhi gcig ste/ bsam se'u la gnas pas/ byang sems dkar dmar gso ba yin pa'i phyir ro//skyes pa la ro tsa bar byas kyang bud med la bud (bu3med na ro tsa ba la 'bras bu med cing khu ba dkar po la gso thabs yod kyang / dmar po la gso thabs med na/ yan lag phyed mar 'gyur ba'i skyon yod/ 'o na yan lag brgyad pho

276 ༄7kho rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogs bsgrigs/mo gnyis dbyer med la/ mo nad gso ba'i yamālag tu pho nad ma 'dus par phyed mar 'gyur ro zhe na/ gso bya'i nad la gso byed kyinyan lag tu ldan pas phyed ma'i sgra mi 'jug ste/ bu gcig la yul kha gcig ltad (gtad3na phyed ma'i sgra med pa bzhin te/ gso yulal lhag ma ma 'dus pa'i phyir ro// rgas pa gso ba stobs bskyed na ro tsa ba shugs las 'byung bas/ yan lag gcig tu 'gyur ro zhes na/ shugs kyis 'byung yang khu ba skam slugs (rlugs3kyi nad mi gsos pas/ spyad (dpyad3gud du dgos pas skyon med do// yang go rim nges pa la/ spyir gso ba rig pa ni tshe'i bar chad srung ba'i thabs yin la/ de la dang po nang gi 'du ba snyoms na tshe'i bar chad 'gyur ba de srung ba'i phyir /gso bar bya ba'i lus yinapas dang por bstan/ de byis pa nas gso dgos pa gnyis par bstan/ byis pa'i rjes la mod tumo3nad 'byung bas/ gsum pa mo nad bstan/ byis pa de tsho 'tshar nas/ blo tuglo3bur ba'i bar chad 'byung ba'i phyir nad ma (mang1nyung gi rim pas tshon (mtshonakadug gdon dang gsum bstan pa'o// tha ma rgas te bar chad du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rgas pa dang ro tsa bstan pa'o// ro tsa ba bar chad du cis 'gyur zhes na/ tshe mthud kyi bar du 'gyur ro//gsum pa gnas la bslab pa ni/ gzhan bcu gcig la zhes pa nas gnas su shes par bya'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis ston te/ gong du gnas bcu gcig la bslab par bya ste/ zhes mdor bstan pa ste/ de yang gang zhe na/ de bshad na 'di lta ste/ gso bshad (dpyad3thams cad kyi rtsa ba mdor bsdus/rtsa rgyud dang bshad brgyud turgyud1kyi le'u dang po'o// rtsa ba mdo'i gnas dang gcig/ 'byung bzhi las lus grub tshul ston pa/ grub pa lus kyi gnas dang gnyis/ rnam par gyur ma gyur dang / lus stobs che chung gis 'phel 'grib byed pas/ 'phel 'grib nad kyi gnas bstan pa dang gsum/ 'phral gyi lus

༄༅kho rgyud kyi 'grelawā rgyud don gsal ba'i nyi ma/ 277ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba spyod lam gyi gnas bstan pa dang bzhi/ 'tsho ba zas skom gyis lus 'tsho bar byed pas/ zas kyi gnas bstan pa dang lnga/ ro nus zhu rjes su sbyor ba bsdebs te bstan pa/ sman gyi gnas dang drug nad dang phyi nang gnas pa'i nad kyi zug ju rnams 'byin par byed pa'i cha spyad (dpyad3dang / spyad tudapyad1kyis nad kyi yul 'byin par byed pa'i gnas dang bdun/tha mal nad med kyis lus nad med par gnas pa'i thab sa dang brgyad/ nad ngos bzung ba rtags la brten nas 'dzin pa/ ngos 'dzin stangs (rtags3kyi gnas dang dgu nad ngos zin pa de/ gso ba'i thabs ston pas na gso thabs kyi gnas dang bcu/ nad gso ba'i thabs dang sman gyi bya ba byed pa sman pa'i gnas dang / de ltar gnas la rnam grangs ni/ bcu gcig gnas su yid las skyes la sogs pas shes par bya'o// de ltar gnas dang grangs las/ go rim nges pa yod dam zhes na/ nges pa med de/ gso spyad skyidapyad1thams cad kyi don mdor bsdus nas ston pa rtsa ba mdo'i gnas dang por bstan/ de don rgyas par bshad pa la/ gang gi don du gso ba lus kyi mtshan nyid shes dgos pas/ gnas gnyis pa grub pa lus kyi gnas bstan/ de'i 'og tu rnam par gyur ma gyur dang / nad kyis lus stobs che chung dang 'phel zadabyed pas ('phel 'grib nad kyi gnas bstan r+pā dang gsum)/ gnas bzhi la tupa3bya ba spyod lam gyi gnas bstan/ de'i 'og tu lus de yang zas dang skom gyis 'tshotshobar byed pas gnas lnga pa 'tsho ba zas’kyi gnas bstan/de'i 'og tu spyod lam dang zas spyod kyis nad ma zhi na sman gtong dgos pas/ro nus zhu rjes bsdebs nas sbyor ba'i thabs gnas drug pa sbyor ba sman gyi gnas bstan/ de'i 'og tu sman gyis nad ma zhi spyad (dpyad3kyis nad yul 'don par byed pas/ dpyad kyi cha spyad skyodapyad3dang / spyad (dpyad3dngos ston pas/ cha spyad skyidapyad1kyi gnas bdun par bstan/ de'i 'og tu

278 ༄tshokho rgyud kyi 'grel pa phyogs bsgrigasngalus tha mal nad med du gnas thabs ston pa/ gnas brgyad pa tha mal nad med kyi gnas bstan/ de'i 'og tu rtags la brten nas nad ngos 'dzin pas na/ gnas dgu pa ngos 'dzin stangs (rtags3kyi gnas bstan/ de'i 'og tu nad gang yin rtags kyis ngos 'dzin pa de bcos dgos pas/ gnas bcu pa gso ba thabs kyi gnas bstan/ de'i 'og tu gong gi de dag thams cad kyang /gdags (bdag1po'i rkyen la rag lus te/ gnas bcu gcig pa bya byed sman pa'i gnas bstan/ de yang 'di0nyid las/ de ltar gso bar byed pa'i gso ba po// bya ba byed pa sman pa'i gnas bstan pa// rgyu dang ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba dang / las dang 'bras bu3ma pyodrug gis bstan // brgyud (rgyu 3ni blo ldan bsam pa dkar ba dang // dam tshig ldan zhing las rnams bzo ba dang //bya ba la brtson mi chos mkhas dang drug/ 'di nyid rgyu yi nang nas mchog ces bya// zhes so// de ltar gnas la rnam grangs bcu gcig kho nar nges shing /go rim yang de ltar nges so/ gal te grangs go rim ma nges na/ ston pa'i tshig lta bur 'gros tu'adres3te/ ston pa sangs rgyas la 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba'i phyir ro// de na gnas bcu gcig kho nar shes par bya'o zhes drang srong pa yid las skyes la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams la gdams pa'o//bzhi pa skabs bco lnga la bslab par gdams pa ni/ skabs bco lnga la bslab ces pas na/ skabs bco lngar shes par bya'o// zhes pa'i bar te/man ngag gi rgyud skabs kyi rnam grangs bco lnga la bslab par bya ste/ de dag ni gang zhe na 'di ltar bstan pa yin te/ rlung mkhris bad kan nyes pa skyed pa'i phyir/ dang po nyes pa gsum gso ba'i skabs bstan/ gnyis pa bad rlung grang ba las gyur pa'i nad gtso bor byas pa khong nad gso ba'i skabs dang bstan pa dang / gsum pa khrag mkhris tsha ba las gyur pa'i nad gtso bor byas pa tshad pa gso ba'i skabasartsobasten pa dang / bzhi pa lus stod la gnas pa tshad pa'i nad
